reason: E2 shows DCT improves strength and ductility in a BCC HEA via phase transition, but does not mention nano-twinning, dislocation rearrangement, or pore reduction. E1 shows cryogenic deformation induces twinning and martensite in a different alloy, not DCT. E3 only confirms SLM processing of CoCrFeNiMn powder. The key premises about DCT inducing nano-twinning, relaxing stresses, and reducing pores in CoCrFeNiMn are unsupported by the cited evidence.
premises: Deep cryogenic treatment of HEAs can induce nano-twinning and dislocation rearrangement
DCT can relax residual stresses and reduce pore density in additively manufactured alloys
DCT improves strength and ductility in HEAs
CoCrFeNiMn HEA can be processed by SLM with standard parameters
